importExport.importMergeInfo:
Merge mode:
- New sets are added to your library
- New characters are added to existing sets
- New scripts are added to your script list
- New script versions are added to your script list
- New options are added

Replace mode:
- Includes merge mode
- Existing characters in sets are replaced
- Existing versions in scripts are replaced

specials.typeInfo:
Currently supported values are:
selection - during character selection,
signal - during night signaling,
ability - when clicking on the character token,
vote - during a vote,
reveal - at the end of the game, before characters are revealed,
player - an ability that can be initiated by the player.
specials.name: Name
specials.nameInfo: This is a list of the currently implemented special features and will be growing over time.
specials.timeInfo: At which point during the game can the ability be used.
specials.globalInfo: If it's a global ability that can be used without the character being in play, this property defines on which characters it can be used. This does not work on Fabled, because they are not considered to be on the Script.

info.reminders: Tokens associated with this role. They help the Storyteller mark various effects affecting the game.
info.remindersGlobal: Tokens available globally in the script, even when the character is not in play. They help the Storyteller mark various effects affecting the game.
info.setup: This character's ability affects the initial game composition before play begins (e.g., Huntsman adds a Damsel).
info.icons: For non-traveller characters, the icons should be regular alignment and flipped alignment, for travellers they should be unaligned, good alignment and evil alignment.
info.scriptCharacterPriority: The value reflects the character's position on the character sheet. The lower the value, the higher the character appears in their team's list.
info.bootleggerRules:
Bootlegger rules for this character.
Don't forget to add NPC Bootlegger in the script to see the bootlegger rules in options.
info.jinxes: Jinxes with other characters on this script.
info.firstNightPriority: First night wake-up priority. "0" means this character doesn't wake during the first night.
info.otherNightPriority: Other nights wake-up priority. "0" means this character doesn't wake during other nights.
